title: Wedelolactone alleviates cholestatic liver injury by regulating FXR-bile acid-NF-kappaB/NRF2 axis to reduce bile acid accumulation and its subsequent inflammation and oxidative stress.
authors: Wang, Mei-Qi; Zhang, Kai-Hui; Liu, Fang-Le; Zhou, Rui; Zeng, Yun; Chen, A-Li; Yu, Yang; Xia, Quan; Zhu, Chen-Chen; Lin, Chao-Zhan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wedelolactone通过FXR-胆汁酸-NF-kappaB/NRF2轴缓解胆汁淤积性肝损伤，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物靶向FXR的湿实验与代谢组学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cholestatic liver diseases (CLD) comprise a variety of disorders of bile formation, which causes chronic exposure to bile acid (BA) in the liver generally and results in hepatotoxicity and progressive hepatobiliary injury. Wedelolactone (7-methoxy-5, 11, 12-trihydroxy-coumestan, WED), the natural active compound derived from Ecliptae Herba, has been reported with valuable bioactivity for liver protection. Nevertheless, the effect of WED on cholestatic liver injury (CLI) remains unexplored. PURPOSE: The present study aims to elucidate the protective effect of WED on Alpha-naphthylisothiocyanate (ANIT)-induced CLI mice, and to investigate its potential pharmacological mechanism. METHODS: The anit-cholestatic and hepatoprotective effects of WED were evaluated in ANIT-induced CLI mice. Non-targeted metabolomics study combined with ingenuity pathway analysis (IPA) was used to explore the key mechanism of WED. The BA metabolic profile in enterohepatic circulation was analyzed to evaluate the effect of WED in regulating BA metabolism. Furthermore, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) were used to simulate and verify the targeting activation of WED on the Farnesoid X receptor (FXR). The core role of FXR in WED promoting BA transportation, and alleviating BA accumulation-induced hepatotoxicity was further evaluated in WT and FXR knockout mice or hepatocytes. RESULTS: WED dose-dependently alleviated ANIT-induced cholestasis and liver injury in mice, and simultaneously suppressed the signaling pathway of nuclear factor-kappa B/nuclear factor-erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NF-kappaB/NRF2) to relieve inflammation and oxidative stress. At the metabolite level, WED improved the metabolic disorder in CLI mice focusing on the metabolism of BA, arachidonic acid, and glycerophospholipid, that closely related to the process of BA regulation, inflammation, and oxidative damage. WED targeting activated FXR, which then transcribed its target genes, including the bile salt export pump (BSEP) and the BA transporter, and subsequently increased BA transportation to restore the damaged enterohepatic circulation of BA. Meanwhile, WED alleviated hepatic BA accumulation and protected the liver from BA-induced damage via NF-kappaB/NRF2 signaling pathway. Furthermore, FXR deficiency suppressed the protective effect of WED in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSION: WED regulated BA metabolism and alleviated hepatic damage in cholestasis. It protected the liver according to adjusted BA transportation and relieved BA accumulation-related hepatotoxicity via FXR-bile acid-NF-kappaB/NRF2 axis. Our study provides novel insights that WED might be a promising strategy for cholestatic liver disease.
abstract_zh: 背景：胆汁淤积性肝病（CLD）包括多种胆汁形成障碍性疾病，通常导致肝脏长期暴露于胆汁酸（BA），进而引发肝毒性和进行性肝胆损伤。蟛蜞菊内酯（7-甲氧基-5, 11, 12-三羟基香豆素，WED）是从旱莲草中提取的天然活性化合物，据报道具有宝贵的肝脏保护生物活性。然而，WED对胆汁淤积性肝损伤（CLI）的作用尚未被探索。目的：本研究旨在阐明WED对α-萘基异硫氰酸酯（ANIT）诱导的CLI小鼠的保护作用，并探讨其潜在药理机制。方法：在ANIT诱导的CLI小鼠中评估WED的抗胆汁淤积和保肝作用。采用非靶向代谢组学研究结合独创性通路分析（IPA）来探索WED的关键机制。分析肠肝循环中的BA代谢谱，以评估WED调节BA代谢的作用。此外，使用分子动力学（MD）模拟和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）来模拟和验证WED对法尼醇X受体（FXR）的靶向激活。在野生型和FXR敲除小鼠或肝细胞中进一步评估FXR在WED促进BA转运和减轻BA积累诱导的肝毒性中的核心作用。结果：WED剂量依赖性地减轻了ANIT诱导的小鼠胆汁淤积和肝损伤，同时抑制核因子-κB/核因子-红细胞2相关因子2（NF-κB/NRF2）信号通路，以缓解炎症和氧化应激。在代谢物水平上，WED改善了CLI小鼠的代谢紊乱，重点关注BA、花生四烯酸和甘油磷脂的代谢，这些与BA调节、炎症和氧化损伤过程密切相关。WED靶向激活FXR，进而转录其靶基因，包括胆汁盐输出泵（BSEP）和BA转运体，随后增加BA转运以恢复受损的BA肠肝循环。同时，WED通过NF-κB/NRF2信号通路减轻了肝脏BA积累，并保护肝脏免受BA诱导的损伤。此外，FXR缺失在体外和体内抑制了WED的保护作用。结论：WED调节BA代谢并减轻胆汁淤积中的肝损伤。它通过FXR-胆汁酸-NF-κB/NRF2轴调整BA转运并缓解BA积累相关的肝毒性来保护肝脏。我们的研究提供了新见解，即WED可能是胆汁淤积性肝病的一种有前景的治疗策略。
